description: BLS CES State and Area (SAE) employment by state-equivalent and CES supersector, monthly, not seasonally adjusted, with every ALFRED real-time vintage (229 vintages from 2007-06-19). The point-in-time employment panel regional_model needs: each row carries the vintage it was published in, so a first-release panel can be built without reading a revised level.

source.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED/ALFRED)
source.originating_source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, State and Area (SAE)
source.license_notes: FRED API Terms of Use (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). The underlying series are US federal statistics (public domain); FRED terms govern API use. Cite FRED and BLS CES State and Area.

sampling.reason: A 100-row excerpt of one series would carry a handful of vintages and could not be told apart from a current-vintage download, which is the exact confusion this dataset exists to remove. pipeline.py refuses to run on anything but the full sharded artifact.

acquisition.description: One FRED API series/observations request per configured series, each over the full real-time window 1776-07-04..9999-12-31 so every ALFRED vintage comes back as [realtime_start, realtime_end] spans. Series are discovered and verified by build_config.py from FRED release 112 (State Employment and Unemployment); combinations here must match config.json (build_config.py --emit-combinations regenerates them). desired_bytes 320 MiB against a measured 0.28-0.46 MiB per series over ~600 series, i.e. ~0.17 GiB expected.
